The only way you get signed out of web sites is if you clear cookies. Vivaldi does not clear cookies on restart unless you ask it to. @ scharti
Maybe you have some third-party process on your system clearing cookies? CCleaner is known to cause such problems for instance, or other "privacy" related programs.
Remove Whatsapp web panel
Log in to the service in a regular tab (not panel!)
Check you have cookies from the site in Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies. Since WA is a Facebook service, cookies from FB might also be needed.
Close and restart the browser
Check you have cookies from the site in Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies
If cookies are gone, has deleted them and that's what you need to figure out something
